svg.title: Non-Hermitian fixed points
svg.desc: Two complex fixed points of the non-Hermitian five-state Potts model, highlighted in the complex coupling plane. Fig. 1(b) from Yin Tang, Han Ma, Qicheng Tang, Yin-Chen He, W. Zhu, Reclaiming the Lost Conformality in a Non-Hermitian Quantum 5-State Potts Model, Physical Review Letters 133, 076504 (2024). https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevLett.133.076504. Panel (b) selected from the original figure PDF and converted to SVG, preserving its embedded raster content. Outer whitespace trimmed and the panel label removed.
